com.google.android.youtube.label: YouTube
com.google.android.youtube.hints: Search icon desc 'Search'. First non-Short, non-Ad row below header is the latest video. Like button desc starts 'like this video'. Subscribe button shows 'Subscribe' or 'Subscribed'. View count is the '<n> views' text under video title.

com.whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
com.whatsapp.hints: Send button has desc 'Send' or id 'send'. Attach menu has 'Location' -> 'Share live location' with duration chips (15 min, 1 hour, 8 hours). Search icon top for chats.

com.instagram.android.label: Instagram
com.instagram.android.hints: Bottom navigation tabs: Home, Search, Create, Reels, Profile. Own story is at top left of Home; swipe up on own story or tap seen-by eye icon to view viewer count. Create -> Story to post.

capcut.label: CapCut
capcut.hints: 'New project' button on home tab. Media picker displays Videos and Photos tabs. Tap thumbnail then 'Add' to place on timeline.

com.android.vending.label: Google Play Store
com.android.vending.hints: Profile avatar at top right -> 'Manage apps & device' -> 'Updates available' -> 'Update all'.

com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.user.label: Google Pay
com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.user.hints: Financial app: Never enter UPI PIN or complete payment. Yield to user.

com.phonepe.app.label: PhonePe
com.phonepe.app.hints: Financial app: Never enter UPI PIN or complete payment. Yield to user.
